subject: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Bobby Chen <bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com>; laura.bennett@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T15:12:00Z
Subject: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps

Hi Bobby / Arcadia team,

Thanks again for partnering on the Q4 Field Summit. We ran our post-event sponsor report and attached the lead export plus a one-page summary. High level: Redwood is attributing $172k influenced pipeline from Arcadia-sponsored sessions (direct conversions within 30 days + MQL->SQL matches). Your notes in the event portal show $240k influenced.

Can we do a quick reconcile? Initial hypotheses: (1) lead dedupe / company mapping differences (HubSpot vs our CRM export), (2) different attribution lookback windows (we used 30 days, I think Arcadia used 90), (3) some leads were tagged as Marketing Qualified in your workflow but didn't progress to SQL in our view.

Ask: please confirm which export you used and whether Arcadia counts demo requests logged by SDRs as influenced pipeline. I propose a 30-minute alignment call Monday to agree rules and produce a single reconciled list for invoice credit discussions.

Attachments: Arcadia_Q4_Sponsor_Leads_20261206.csv (lead export), Redwood_Sponsor_Report_Q4_summary.pdf (summary + methodology), invoice_ARC-4579.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference platform

From: Bobby Chen <bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadia-analytics.com
Date: 2026-12-07T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps

Marcus — thanks for the quick send and for the thorough summary. We pulled the sponsor-side report this morning; our total influenced number (the $240k) is from a 90-day lookback and includes opportunities where a demo was logged by our SDRs even if no SQL tag was created in HubSpot. I attach the export we used — you should see the demo_request and demo_completed flags.

Preliminary differences we see: ~25 leads that were deduped on company name in your file but kept as unique leads in ours because they had different contact emails; and ~7 opportunities that were manually created by our enterprise reps after phone conversations (those were not captured in the event-form export).

We agree a short call would help. Monday 10:00–10:30 PT works for us.

Best,
Bobby Chen
Head of Partnerships | Arcadia Analytics
bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>; Bobby Chen <bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com; stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-07T11:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps

Thanks Bobby — helpful context. A couple quick notes from our side before the call:

- HubSpot mapping: our export filters by "Event = Q4 Field Summit" and stage progression to SQL within 30 days. If Arcadia is including demo_logged as influenced we should align on whether demo_logged alone constitutes pipeline credit or only when it transitions to an opportunity.
- Dedupe rules: we currently dedupe by email + domain for enterprise accounts; that explains the ~25 you mention. We can run a relaxed dedupe (company + name similarity) for the mutual reconciliation and surface duplicates side-by-side.
- Manual opportunities: please flag the 7 manually created opps and share the rep names — we can match those to our CRM by rep-owner and close date.

I'll prepare a drive folder with a reconciled template (side-by-side rows) and a short methodology doc.

— Laura
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Bobby Chen <bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com; stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-08T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps

Bobby / team — appreciate the openness. Proposed mutual action plan before Monday's call:

1) Each side drops their lead export into the shared Drive folder (Arcadia: the export you mentioned; Redwood: we already uploaded the CSV).
2) Ops (Laura) to run a relaxed dedupe and generate a match-key column (email OR company+name fuzzy match).
3) Sales/Partnerships (Arcadia) to flag the 7 manual opps and provide rep-IDs.
4) We run a 30 vs 90 day sensitivity in the reconciliation template to show how totals change.
5) If reconciled influenced pipeline differs by >10%, discuss invoice crediting (we have precedent to prorate sponsor fees).

We should keep the call to 30 minutes and focus on producing the reconciled spreadsheet. If either side needs deeper forensic analysis we can spin up a follow-up session.

I can host the meeting in Calendar if Marcus confirms Monday 10 PT.

— Marissa
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Bobby Chen <bobby.chen@arcadia-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com; procurement@arcadia-analytics.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 field sponsorship report — reconciliation & next steps

Marissa / Marcus — Monday 10 PT is confirmed on our side. I'll add the 7 manual opps spreadsheet to the Drive folder and include rep IDs. One quick ask for the call: can you surface the query or saved view used to generate the Redwood report so we can capture filter parity on the screen? That will speed agreement.

See you Monday.

Regards,
Bobby
